speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: HI! HAVE YOU HEARD OF SAVE THE CHILDREN BEFORE?

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: No I haven't. What is it?

speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: IT'S AN AMAZING GLOBAL CHARITY THAT HELPS CHILDREN IN DANGEROUS AREAS!

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: That sounds really cool. Do they have a main country they focus on, like Haiti or somewhere in Africa?

speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: NO, AS A MATTER OF FACT THE CHARITY HAS TIES ACROSS THE WORLD, ALTHOUGH IT IS CURRENTLY HEAVILY INVESTED IN THE SYRIA REGION!

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: What kind of things do they provide for the children? Do they provide shelter and basic needs?

speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: THE MAIN FOCUS IS USUALLY HEALTH SUCH AS MOBILE HOSPITALS OR EDUCATION, WITH DEPLOYED TEACHERS

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: Do these teachers go all over the world, or are they specific to that country?

speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: ALL THE INSTRUCTORS IN THE SAVE THE CHILDREN ARE SENT IN GROUPS ON ROTATING DEPLOYMENTS OF 6 MONTHS, USUALLY TO A FEW TARGET COUNTRIES.

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: Are the instructors volunteers? What is the process of becoming one of the instructors?

speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: ALL INSTRUCTORS MUST SPEAK TWO LANGUAGES AND HAVE TWO YEARS OF FORMAL TEACHING.  THEY CAN THEN APPLY TO A SPECIFIC MISSION AS THEY COME UP, USUALLY 6 MONTHS AHEAD OF THE START DATE.

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: I imagine it's pretty hard to go overseas for so long in a different country. What kind of experience have the prior instructors had?

speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: MANY HAVE LOVED IT ALTHOUGH IT CAN BE CHALLENGING, THE INSTRUCTORS ARE PAID VERY LITTLE BUT GIVEN FREE ROOM/BOARD.  HOWEVER AFTER ONE YEAR OF WORK THEY CAN APPLY THRU A SPECIAL PROGRAM TO BE CITIZENS OF THE HOST COUNTRY.

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: That's a really cool deal. Do they get dual citizenship or is it more of an ex-pat type situation?

speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: THEY CAN BECOME A DUAL CITIZEN AFTER 1 YEAR IN THE PROGRAM. IN SOME CASES OUR INSTRUCTORS HAVE FOUND FULL TIME JOBS WITHIN THE HOST COUNTRY AFTER THEIR TENURE.

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: What are some of the improvements in quality of life for the children?

speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: MANY OF OUR CHILDREN PUT ON GLASSES FOR THE FIRST TIME BECAUSE THEY HAVE NEVER VISITED AN EYE DOCTOR.  JUST A 2 DOLLAR DONATION CAN GET ONE OF OUR SPONSOR CHILDREN ACCESS TO A COMPREHENSIVE MEDICAL SCREENING.

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: Do they often get a chance to get a more thorough education than prior to becoming a part of the program?

speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: IT DEPENDS ON THE HOST COUNTRY AND ITS RULES, FOR EXAMPLE FEW GIRLS IN SYRIA HAD EVEN BASIC READING SKILLS DUE TO DISCRIMINATORY SCHOOL POLICIES.  WOULD YOU BE INTERESTED IN DONATING TO OUR EDUCATION FUND?

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: I can't do much but I'd be willing to donate $0.20

speaker: A19P7S5OYZS61Z
text: GREAT SAVE THE CHILDREN APPRECIATES ALL DONATIONS!

speaker: AAE3H2UOP7YXW
text: Best of luck!
